string.text: When a faction-enemy hits any member of a squad, the entire squad is force-disclosed to the shooter on hit #1: each online squadmate gets the shooter pinned as hostile in their relation registry, has their memory of the shooter enabled, and is flagged as combat-active so the engine propagates the shooter into their visual/sound/hit memory. Extends the engine's audio-range squad disclosure to distant patrol members and suppressed-weapon victims.

Master toggle. When off, the hit handler skips entirely: no squad disclosure, no per-shooter hostility pin, no combat-mask flip. Vanilla engine behavior runs unmodified (audio-range squadmates still propagate hit memory through the engine's own pipeline; distant patrol members do not). The squad-memory substrate stays available for other systems to read. Default: on.

How long a per-shooter entry stays in the squad's combat memory after the last hit from that shooter. Lower = squads forget snipers quickly. Higher = sustained pressure keeps disclosed shooters in memory. Default: 60.

Per-stalker healing behaviors. Medkit and bandage item lists restored at boot via DLTX overlay on ai_tweaks/xr_eat_medkit.ltx (vanilla ships them empty, so stalkers carrying kits never use them). Sections below tune the runtime layer.

Master toggle for the runtime healing layer: heal-rate scaling and per-rank healing-charge override. When off, vanilla self-heal behavior runs unmodified. Restart required to toggle. The medkit and bandage item-list restoration is a boot-time DLTX overlay and is always active. Default: on.

Scales the per-tick HP recovery during a self-heal cycle. Vanilla restores 0.05 HP per tick for 13 ticks (0.65 HP total). At 2.0x each tick restores 0.10 HP; at 0.5x each tick restores 0.025 HP. The tick count is fixed by the engine. Default: 1.0.

Probability that a novice-rank stalker is granted a lifetime healing token at first spawn. The token fires once if the stalker drops below the medkit health threshold without a medkit in inventory. Vanilla rolls 50% for every rank. Default: 50.

Out-of-combat stalkers below the HP threshold visibly limp: an idle torso slump while standing, a damaged walk cycle while moving. Re-armed every 5 seconds per NPC. Combat NPCs are excluded so combat posture is not disrupted. Default: on.
HP fraction below which an eligible stalker starts limping. 0.65 means limping kicks in at 65% HP and below. Lower values delay the visual cue until the stalker is more seriously hurt. Default: 0.65.
Plays a medkit-injection or bandage-application torso animation when a stalker starts a heal cycle. The engine clears the animation when it completes. One-shot cue per cycle. Default: on.

Stalkers in vanilla fire with one shared dispersion - the engine's rank curve is dead at Anomaly's rank values. AlifeTactics restores per-rank scaling so masters shoot tighter than novices. Tune each tier below.
Master toggle for the per-shot accuracy hook. When off, the engine's default (flat) dispersion applies to every stalker regardless of rank. Default: on.
Dispersion for novice-rank stalkers. Lower = tighter shot cone = more lethal. 1.00 matches vanilla engine baseline. Default: 1.00.
Dispersion for legend-rank stalkers (max tier). Default: 0.38.

Forces sniper and launcher carriers to crouch when the engine combat planner selects a static-cover firing or peek action (LookOut, HoldPosition). The crouch persists into subsequent KillEnemy, WaitInCover, and HoldAmbushLocation actions because the engine inherits body_state across those operators. Lower silhouette, tighter dispersion, stable firing position from cover. Other weapon kinds (rifle, pistol, shotgun, SMG, knife) keep vanilla stance. The weapon check reads the active item's "kind" field directly: w_sniper and w_launcher crouch, everything else passes through.
Master toggle. When off, the engine's chosen body state passes through unchanged. Default: on.

Debug and development tools. DEBUG enables structured tracing of every system: hit disclosure events, squad-memory decay, healing ticks and charges, per-shot accuracy, stance overrides, and limping cues. Written to alifetactics.log. Has performance cost; leave at WARN for normal play.
Controls log verbosity. ERROR: crashes only. WARN: anomalies. INFO: module init and patch installs. DEBUG: full per-event tracing.

Restore all AlifeTactics MCM settings to factory defaults. Use after upgrading from a version with different MCM structure (the old settings remain as orphaned keys in the MCM storage file but no longer apply).
Warning: save or discard pending MCM changes first; otherwise they override the reset on the next Accept.
